title: AMQP: call sub dissector via UAT
description:
These changes model an existing table in MQTT dissector. 
There is now a new preferences entry, "Protocol Preferences -> Advanced Message Queueing Protocol -> Message Decoding ..." which is registered via uat_new(). In these preferences, which are saved and restored by wireshark, the user can create a entries in the table with the columns:

"Match criteria" "Topic pattern" "Payload protocol" "Additional Data".

This table allow a user use the `amqp.message.to.string` to select their desired dissector to process the main message data `amqp.data`.

Our use case sets 'protobuf' as the payload protocol, and it is expected the additional data will be used to select a protobuf type definition from files co-located with the preferences file. However any other dissector may be invoked and additional data may be null or whatever is required by that dissector.

commits_data.title: AMQP: subdissector via UAT
commits_data.message:
AMQP: subdissector via UAT

Users can define conditions in UAT to map amqp.message.to.string to a protocol
to use as a subdissector. Users can define the following conditions:
1) Equals
    Uses selected protocol when amqp.message.to.string matches exactly to users
    given string.
2) Contains
    Uses selected protocol when amqp.message.to.string contains the user defined
    string.
3) Starts with
    Uses selected protocol when amqp.message.to.string starts with user defined
    string.
4) Ends with
    Uses selected protocol when amqp.message.to.string ends with user defined string.
5) Regex
    Uses selected protocol when amqp.message.to.string matches user defined regex
    string.

Whenever the type being processed is hf_amqp_1_0_data an attempt is made to find
a match it the UAT and then dissect it.

The UAT contains columns for:
match criteria: type of conditional to use.
topic pattern: string to compare to amqp.message.to.string.
payload proto: protocol to use to dissect the data.
additional data: additional data that is passed to the dissector. (Optional)
